note: Real ancient art and old prints under open licences. 'copied' items have a file here; 'link-only' items are listed with their checked licence and are fetched by tools/fetch-real.mjs. Credit every CC BY item as its 'attribution' says. 'skipped' lists files left out and why. Built by tools/import-real.py; do not edit by hand.
gaps: No allowed-licence image was found for Euryalus, the Arethusa spring, the Temple of Apollo, a trireme, Damon and Pythias, Timoleon or the Motya Charioteer (the photos seen were share-alike). No coin of Akragas, Gela, Selinus, Himera, Segesta, Leontini, Naxos, Messana, Kamarina, Motya or Panormus was found with an allowed licence. Leads not yet checked: Cleveland Museum of Art coin files (often CC0), Gallica coin files (public domain) of Syracuse and Carthage, more Sailko 2014-2015 uploads (CC BY 3.0).
